scope: Proposition 16.2 (Maximal deformation output) of the manuscript “Boundary graph deformations for the spacetime Penrose inequality” (preprints/Boundary-graph-deformations-for-the-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4205f51d8f1b130b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 113. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (M, g, K) be a smooth connected orientable four-dimensional ball exterior, complete including its compact boundary S, with one Euclidean coordinate end. Let r ≥ 1 be a fixed smooth positive extension of its Euclidean radius. Suppose 1 < q < 2, 0 < δ < q − 1, trg K = 0, g−δEucl = O2(r−q ), K = O1(r−1−q ), Rg = O(r−4−δ ), µ−|J| ≥ c0r−4−δ > 0, and suppose HS + trS K < 0. Assume finite ADM energy and uniform bounds of every fixed derivative order on end patches of unit size. Write A∗ = Ag(S) for the infimum over all smooth enclosing cuts, including disconnected cuts. There is a smooth cut B enclosing S, with connected one-ended exterior Ω, such that for each 0 < ϵ < 1 and all sufficiently large integers N there is a smooth metric b gN on Ω satisfying b gN ≥ e−2ϵ g, Rb gN ≥ 0, b HB < 0, Eb gN ≤ Eg + ΠN 3ω3 (e−ϵN + e−ϵN/2 ). Here ΠN has polynomial growth at fixed strict data and ϵ. The new metric is complete including B, has b gN −δEucl = O2(r−q) and Rb gN = O(r−4−δ), and every smooth cut enclosing B has b gN -area at least e−3ϵA∗.
